scope: Proposition 6.5 (Approximation by the finite coefficient) of the manuscript “An asymptotic formula for the number of totients” (preprints/An-asymptotic-formula-for-the-number-of-totients-September-25-2026/An-asymptotic-formula-for-the-number-of-totients-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 024 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5dda4f860a38357f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are numbers εH → 0 such that, for every f : [1, ∞) → [0, 1], lim sup x→∞ Mf (x; H) Gm − AH(f; θ(x)) ≤ εH. (6.11) The bound is independent of f and of phase. Each AH(f; s) is a finite sum involving values of f at explicitly bounded rational arguments and absolutely convergent series in its exponential weights, and AH(f; s) ≥ 0.
